coverage: A 24147ms initial lookup and subsequent private registration succeed within the same 60000ms deadline.
A 24147ms lookup followed by a 40000ms privacy operation fails at the original 60000ms deadline.
Polling is clipped to remaining time; expiration starts no extra command and closes the temporary forwarder.
Existing authentication/error, malformed output, public-port privacy change and forwarding cleanup cases still pass.
regression.clockMethod: Node built-in test mock Date/setTimeout; subprocess replies and command deadlines advance on the same clock. This reproduces the timeout contract deterministically without asserting that a real provider is slow on demand.
regression.harnessNote: The initial negative test left its mock sleep unadvanced and was stopped. The test was bounded and rerun: all three new cases then failed on old code and passed on the fix.

scope: Full local and isolated Linux suites; native provider verification is a separate gate.
